🏎️ *Vector Pit Crew — main — October 23 8 AM Pacific cutoff: red flag*

🔴 *Nightly:* 0/1 green · 0 green days · 8 failed jobs · <https://github.com/NVIDIA/cuvs/actions/runs/39907479206|nightly evidence> · latest 2026-10-23: red · <https://github.com/NVIDIA/cuvs/actions/runs/39907479206|latest cycle>

*Clean full passes*
```
Period     CI       n  Min(h) Mean(h) Max(h) Std dev(h)
Current    PR       2    0.63    1.09   1.55       0.46
Prior 7d   Nightly  1    2.68    2.68   2.68       0.00
Prior 7d   PR      23    0.60    1.69   4.93       1.10
```

🔧 *Pit stops:* 3 additional PR CI attempts across 3/25 CI-observed commits; late-stage 3/9 commits rerun.

🏁 *Today's race plan*
1. 🟥 *P0 · Red flag* — Compressed-size validation blocks four libcuvs wheel matrices across both architectures and CUDA versions, with eight failed executions and no recovery. Compare wheel contents and size budgets across all four affected matrices. Identify the excess payload, correct packaging or justify a revised budget, and rerun the affected builds. <https://github.com/NVIDIA/cuvs/actions/runs/39907479206/job/120434027204|Evidence>. *Finish line:* All four wheel lanes pass size validation and a paired nightly build-and-test cycle passes.

*Trackside watchlist:* 3 groups / 6 jobs in thread; 0 still have unknown cause.

_Pit-crew call: Main has a red flag. Clear the wheel-size gate and verify the full lap._

🪶 *Vector Aero Room — ARM64 binary weigh-in*
Holding weight.
```
CUDA | Previous MB | Current MB | Δ MB | Δ %
  12 | 607.97 | 607.97 | +0.00 | +0.00%
  13 | 323.93 | 323.93 | +0.00 | +0.00%
```
CUDA 12: <https://conda.anaconda.org/rapidsai-nightly/linux-aarch64/libcuvs-26.12.00a152-cuda12_261023135132_f492bb36.conda|Oct 23 14:47 UTC> vs <https://conda.anaconda.org/rapidsai-nightly/linux-aarch64/libcuvs-26.12.00a151-cuda12_261023054504_3dd62c14.conda|Oct 23 06:15 UTC>. 3 earlier publication(s) superseded.
CUDA 13: <https://conda.anaconda.org/rapidsai-nightly/linux-aarch64/libcuvs-26.12.00a152-cuda13_261023135132_f492bb36.conda|Oct 23 14:48 UTC> vs <https://conda.anaconda.org/rapidsai-nightly/linux-aarch64/libcuvs-26.12.00a151-cuda13_261023054504_3dd62c14.conda|Oct 23 06:15 UTC>. 3 earlier publication(s) superseded.
Device targets — CUDA 12: sm_100, sm_120, sm_120a, sm_70, sm_75, sm_80, sm_86, sm_90a; CUDA 13: sm_100, sm_120, sm_120a, sm_75, sm_80, sm_86, sm_90a.

*Wind-tunnel worklist — uncompressed code-size opportunities*
Evidence: CUDA packages linked above. For each specialization, trace translation-unit copies and compare compilation inputs.
1. 🔧 *P2 · Weight cut 1* — `raft::matrix::detail::select::warpsort::block_kernel<warp_sort_immediate, 256, true, float, unsigned int, dense_layout<unsigned int> >` in libcuvs.so. CUDA 12: 10.714 MB, 40 copies (32 excess); CUDA 13: 8.452 MB, 35 copies (28 excess); identical code sections within each target.
2. 🔧 *P2 · Weight cut 2* — `raft::matrix::detail::select::warpsort::block_kernel<warp_sort_immediate, 256, false, float, unsigned int, dense_layout<unsigned int> >` in libcuvs.so. CUDA 12: 10.706 MB, 40 copies (32 excess); CUDA 13: 8.446 MB, 35 copies (28 excess); identical code sections within each target.
3. 🔧 *P2 · Weight cut 3* — `raft::matrix::detail::select::warpsort::block_kernel<warp_sort_immediate, 256, true, int, unsigned int, dense_layout<unsigned int> >` in libcuvs.so. CUDA 12: 8.020 MB, 32 copies (24 excess); CUDA 13: 6.324 MB, 28 copies (21 excess); identical code sections within each target.
*Finish line for each cut:* fewer copies and a measured reduction in the rebuilt shared library.
_MB = 1,000,000 bytes. Opportunities are uncompressed device-code estimates, not verified library savings. PTX-only and tile-IR duplication excluded._
